mechanism: Have the qualified device router emit a second permutation of score-ranked slots in ascending expert-ID order without changing diagnostic IDs or aligned weights.

device_contract.input: The already-qualified score-ranked expert IDs and aligned normalized weights.
device_contract.output: A u32 slot permutation sorted by ascending expert ID.
device_contract.weight_alignment: Execution slots index the original score-ranked IDs and weights; weights are not reordered.
device_contract.sort: Stable insertion sort in one bounded router thread; flagship experts_per_token=8 and the kernel rejects experts_per_token greater than 64.

numeric_parity_v2_1.authority: Complete-token FP64 accumulation from the 586,019-byte direct-u8 sparse fixture.

assertions: score-ranked expert IDs preserve stable lower-index ties
aligned normalized weights preserve the host authority
execution slots index selected experts in ascending expert-ID order

qualification.qualified: The device now owns the exact routed-expert execution permutation required by an indirect cache-hit expert path.
not_qualified: No selected expert weight is addressed on device from this permutation yet.
The current production path still reads selected IDs and weights on the host.
No command-buffer boundary, readback, or flagship latency has been removed by this prerequisite alone.
No cache-indexed address table, generation check, resource lease, or fail-closed miss path exists yet.
qualification.next_boundary: Add the tagged Rust/Metal expert descriptor ABI and a default-off, one-layer immutable cache-hit table proof with readiness and generation checks before raw-address dereference.
